text:
maria: Heads-up: finalizing the release notes for the docs deploy tomorrow. Scope: snippet parity (Node + Python), a focused link/image rot pass, and migration notes for v0.9 -> v1.0 breaking bits.

nick: I ran a quick audit and found 11 external links to old-host.example.com + 3 images 404ing under /integrations. Will prioritize redirects for the top-traffic pages.

tasha: I'll tackle the images. Two assets were renamed in the design repo; proposing we move them to /static/assets/v1/ and add redirects for legacy paths.

maria: Agreed — stable asset paths sound good. Add a short note in the relnotes about rewritten asset URLs so integrators know to update cached copies.

devon: I'll own Python snippets. There's a streaming example that currently assumes browser APIs. I'll add both sync/async server-side variants and a note about using an AbortController analog in Python async streams.

maria: Can we keep canonical snippet sources in this repo under /samples/snippets? We want docs builds to include the same files we test.

nick: Yes, that avoids cross-repo drift. I'll update the docs build config to pull from /samples/snippets.

linkbot: auto-check: docs lint flagged unclosed code block at integrations/s3.md: line 42 and broken images: /integrations/s3/img1.png, /guides/quickstart/diagram.svg. See ops/linkbot-2026-03-22 for the mapping.

maria: Thanks — Nick, can you open a tiny PR for the s3 snippet fence? Tasha, once you reupload the images, please add the stable path mapping in the PR description.

tasha: On it. Uploading now and will include mappings + a note to ops for CDN cache purge.

devon: Small SDK rename to call out in migration steps: Node: client.create_stream -> client.stream. I'll include an old vs new snippet and a one-line migration tip.

maria: Include a short example that shows both. Also add a known-issue entry for: "Dedicated capacity cold-starts after kernel invalidation" with workaround = gradual warm-up traffic; link to infra/1234. Ops said they're tracking it.

ops-bot: incident-ref: infra/1234 referenced. Workaround: warm-up traffic; ETA for fix: TBD.

nick: Redirects PR opened for 5 high-priority pages. Tagging reviewers @maria @devon. I'll also add canonical meta tags on the new paths.

maria: Timeline: get PRs open by EOD, reviews tomorrow AM, merge before docs deploy at 9:30am PT. I'll assemble relnotes draft after PRs land and post for review in #docs. Please tag PRs with 'relnotes-ready'.

linkbot: reminder: run full linkcheck after merges (job: infra/linkcheck-postmerge).

maria: Thanks all. Small ask — if you see any param renames or tokenization differences that affect examples, flag them now so I can include explicit migration steps.
